eligibility.criteria_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with hypercholesterolemia
* Patients diagnosed with metabolic syndrome or type 2 diabetes mellitus, and presenting with elevated LDL-C

Exclusion Criteria:

* New-onset acute cardio-cerebrovascular disease
* Severe hepatic impairment
* Active liver disease

interventions.description: Administered as a fixed-dose combination tablet (Pitavastatin/Ezetimibe 4/10 mg) orally once daily for 52 weeks.
interventions.name: Pitavastatin 4mg

interventions.description: Administered as a fixed-dose combination tablet (Pitavastatin/Ezetimibe 4/10 mg) orally once daily for 52 weeks.
interventions.name: Ezetimibe 10 mg

interventions.description: Administered as a matching placebo tablet identical in appearance to the Pitavastatin/Ezetimibe 4/10 mg fixed-dose combination, orally once daily for 52 weeks.
interventions.name: Placebo (for Pitavastatin/Ezetimibe)

interventions.description: Administered as a matching placebo tablet identical in appearance to Pitavastatin 4 mg monotherapy, orally once daily for 52 weeks.
interventions.name: Placebo (for Pitavastatin)

outcomes.description: The unit of measure is percentage (%). The percentage change is calculated as: \[(Value at Week 8 - Value at Baseline) / Value at Baseline\] \* 100
outcomes.measure: Percentage change from baseline in LDL Cholesterol at Week 8 after the first dose of study treatment

outcomes.description: Change = (Value at Week 8, 24, or 52) - (Value at Baseline), Unit of measure: mg/dL
outcomes.measure: Change from baseline in HDL Cholesterol at Weeks 8, 24, and 52 after the first dose of study treatment

outcomes.description: Change = (Value at Week 8, 24, or 52) - (Value at Baseline), Unit of measure: mg/dL
outcomes.measure: Change from baseline in Triglycerides at Weeks 8, 24, and 52 after the first dose of study treatment

outcomes.description: Change = (Value at Week 8, 24, or 52) - (Value at Baseline), Unit of measure: mg/dL
outcomes.measure: Change from baseline in LDL Cholesterol at Weeks 8, 24, and 52 after the first dose of study treatment

outcomes.description: The NLFS is a calculated score used to estimate liver fat content. The change is calculated as (Value at Week 24 or 52) - (Value at Baseline).
outcomes.measure: Change from baseline in Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease Liver Fat Score (NLFS) at Weeks 24 and 52

trial.brief_summary: A multicenter, randomized, double-blind, phase Ⅳ study to evaluate the long-term efficacy and safety of Pitavastatin/Ezetimibe and Pitavastatin in patients with hypercholesterolemia with elevated triglycerides
trial.brief_title: Long-term Comparison of Pitavastatin/Ezetimibe and Pitavastatin in Patients With Hypercholesterolemia and Elevated Triglycerides
